title: Official gold-flow publication timing and operational limits
author: World Gold Council; IMF

chunks.heading: Two-month reporting lag
chunks.body: World Gold Council monthly official gold-reserve files are normally updated within the first ten days of a month with data two months in arrears; late reporters can refer to still earlier periods and corrections can alter the series.

chunks.heading: Intentions are not a live flow feed
chunks.body: The central-bank intentions survey is annual, voluntary, anonymous and aggregated. It measures attitudes over a fieldwork window, not executable purchase timing by institution.

chunks.heading: Context only
chunks.body: Reported central-bank gold flows may label a slow regime from their actual publication date onward. Aligning them to the reference month creates lookahead, so they cannot be used as contemporaneous weekly entry triggers or post-hoc rescue explanations.
